detectionScenario.anchorFilter: fundId + occurredAt >= shockAt + submittedAt >= shockAt + rawScore >= tau

disclosureDetectionLagSec.R0: epoch-aligned, varies with run clock within [systemLag, systemLag + 604800); smoke asserts disclosedAt % 604800 == 0

detectionScenario.aggregateThresholdCensoring: tau=6000 equals the public red band boundary, so no rows are censored in the baseline scenario; non-boundary thresholds yield censored(threshold_not_identifiable) for aggregate-granularity public views

independentReproduction.environment: isolated cloud sandbox (Ubuntu 24.04, Node 22, forge 1.5.1, solc 0.8.30, PostgreSQL 16)
independentReproduction.result: all checks passed; test counts, coverage percentages, runtime code sizes, gate/stale scores, postgres persistence counts identical to the CI run; R0 lag differs only by run clock as documented

notes: Risk inputs were read at one fixed block and committed with payload schema version 3 (chainId + registry address + fundId + snapshot block domain binding).

Subscription mints shares as SubscriptionAmount*1e18/NAV on-chain; post-initial NAV is computed on-chain as NetAssetValue*1e18/TotalSharesSnapshot with the share snapshot read from the token at a fixed block; redemption records the settlement-time NAV and cash amount. Math.mulDiv floors in the fund-favorable (anti-dilutive) direction.
FundToken is immutably bound to its NAVRegistry; the API validates fundId and registry binding at startup and refuses to start on mismatch (asserted end-to-end).
Risk submission, liquidity submission, and gate release roles were assigned to separate accounts and removed from admin after deployment (Deploy.t.sol + on-chain cast checks).
Smoke is a compressed functional test; the dedicated scenario output is the evidence source for all three DetectionLag measures.

Complete raw logs and evidence files are retained in the GitHub Actions artifact referenced above; SHA-256 digests for all 14 artifact files are recorded in docs/evidence/chapter3-artifact-sha256.txt.
